purpose: Choose the less bad of two unwelcome alternatives.
keywords: Plain form + ほうがましだ
Staying silent is better than lying.
The corridor is better than that room.
A little sleep is better than staying up all night.
formation: Plain form + ほうがましだ
restrictions: The preferred option is still not ideal.
mistake: It is weaker praise than ほうがいい.
